headline: The first-holiday moments nobody tells you you'll miss most…
items: Asleep through the loudest dinner of the year, right in the middle of it
Passed down the table like the gravy, and back to you a little sticky
The tiny outfit bought for one day, worn for twenty minutes
Grandpa's face the second they grab his finger
turn: Next year they'll sit up for it. You'll miss when they slept through.
